title: AgentLeak: privacy-leakage testing for agentic AI systems
description: AgentLeak audits complete AI-agent execution traces for privacy leakage across eight channels. Version 0.11.5 bundles 266 scenarios with complete source, license and attribution metadata and supports deterministic, NER-assisted and semantic detection tiers.
notes: Release 0.11.5 removes the unresolved-provenance fixture pack, provides complete pack attribution, and adds REUSE/SPDX licensing metadata.
